title: Chapter 2 · Two players
description: Gerard (player 1) and Aitor (player 2, second controller) in the Meridiana flat: Aitor follows until a second controller connects, then walks on his own with the camera framing both; the status screen splits in two, Gerard's half on the left and Aitor's on the right, and the Noísta ánima is shared; in a fight the screen splits too, Gerard's dock left and Aitor's right, each player picks their own fighter's moves and ánima, and Aitor's turn waits while there is no second controller. Two standard gamepads are faked in the page.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads;

steps.caption: One controller: Aitor walks round the bed and follows Gerard
A second controller connects: Aitor walks on his own and the camera frames both
Estado with two players: Gerard's half on the left, Aitor's on the right, each with their own stats
Ánimas in Aitor's half: he puts Noísta on (Magia +2, Espíritu +2, Defensa −1)
A split fight: Gerard's dock on the left (his vitals, his ánima, his commands), Aitor's on the right; Gerard (faster) goes first
E (R on a controller) changes Gerard's ánima on his turn without spending it: Matemágico, his face and model light up and his dock takes its gold
Aitor's turn: the commands move to his dock on the right and belong to player 2's controller
Player 2's L puts Noísta on Aitor: two players, two ánimas, each half in its own colours, the L / R keys in his pad's buttons
Player 2's controller opens Aitor's skills: in his mirrored dock they slide out to the left
Without a second controller Aitor's turn waits for player 2
